text:
You need a web developer who can work in a Docker container on Ubuntu Server and build with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Laravel.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help you work cleanly in your Ubuntu/Docker setup and build the features you need with React and TypeScript, while fitting into an existing codebase.

Recently, I built embedded customer analytics for a B2B SaaS product, rolling it out to 140 customer accounts and delivering it 3 weeks early. I also built an end-to-end test suite for a broker quoting flow using Docker and TypeScript, with 160 tests that reduced release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1.

If you’d like, I can help you get started quickly and keep the work moving smoothly.
